title: #59 Matt Neal, BRR Motorsport BMW M3, BTCC 1991
note: Neal drove #59 at round 9 (Oulton Park, 11 August) in the British Gas Resource scheme: white, blue 'British Gas' and red 'RESOURCE' across the doors, 'For industry and commerce' on the sill, Esso and 59 on the front door, '100+ Wheels' on the front wing, Shell on the rear quarter. Only right-side pictures exist (Super Touring Register 4698 and 4699, both 'Neal' on the window); the layout is mirrored to the left side with the text reading normally, and sizes measured on 4698 against the wheelbase and door. The Getty rear view of Neal's #18 at round 7 (2201221866) shows the same British Gas Resource sponsor. No TV caption drawing of this version. Wheels: gold mesh with a polished lip, from STR 4698/4699 (on track); no standing photo found. QA round: the small 'British Touring Car Championship' lines added under the ESSO header, as on every 1991 board in the photos. Logos (2026-11-16): the Shell pecten and Shell wordmark are now real logos, and a CHAMPION logo is added on the sill under the number board (STR 4698, right side, mirrored). British Gas stays lettering: the logo file is the 'British Gas E&P' version, while the car has plain upright letters; the flame symbol after 'Gas' is not drawn because its exact artwork is not readable. RESOURCE, FOR INDUSTRY AND COMMERCE and 100+ WHEELS stay lettering (no logo files). Witch Sign Co is added as lettering on the rear quarter; its witch figure is left out.
